title: Agent Install
intro: Download a ready-to-run installer ZIP for fresh Windows PCs.

instructions.title: How to install
instructions.description: Provision a new PC with the kanade agent in three steps.

steps.one: Choose the options below and download the installer ZIP.
steps.two: Copy the ZIP to the target PC and extract it.

instructions.autoNote: Service registration and failure-recovery settings are provisioned automatically — and when command signing is enabled, the backend's command-signing public key is embedded too.
instructions.breakGlassNote: Break-glass keys are not part of the ZIP and must still be distributed separately.

download.title: Download installer
download.description: The ZIP contains kanade-agent.exe, a pre-filled agent.toml, and the install scripts (install.cmd / install-agent.ps1).
download.noReleases: No agent release has been published yet. Publish one first with kanade agent publish (or the Rollout page).
download.natsUrlPlaceholder: Empty = this backend's configured NATS URL
download.natsUrlHint: Left empty, the ZIP uses the NATS URL this backend is configured with. Remote PCs need a broker address they can actually reach.
download.natsTokenPlaceholder: Only when the broker requires a token

signing.enabled: This backend signs commands (kid {{kid}}, fingerprint {{fingerprint}}) — the public key is embedded into the ZIP automatically.
signing.disabled: This backend is not signing commands, so the ZIP will not provision command keys.
